chunks: Undoubtedly they will be losers in the life to come.

key_terms.الْآخِرَةِ: The Hereafter / The life to come

ai.seo_question: Who are considered the greatest losers in the Hereafter according to Surah Hud?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Hud underscores the certainty of loss for a specific group in the Hereafter, serving as a theological affirmation of divine justice. It highlights that their status as the greatest losers is an undeniable fact, rooted in their rejection of truth. The phrase 'la jama'ana' (no doubt) emphasizes the absolute nature of this divine decree.
